scope: Original Q7 solid-line raster paths and original 8-bit GDI context/bitmap setup; synthetic buffer binding and identity scaling.

replay.fixture: Original 8-bit context template; synthetic default and ID17 binding; identity coordinate scaling.

findings.branches: After coordinate conversion with identity-scale fixture, style0 uses the direct word loop if width%32==0 and x%2==0, otherwise the halfword loop if width%16==0 and x%2==0; remaining cases set the brush and dispatch shape0 through GDI. Branch selection is original code. These tests do not establish physical unaligned-store behavior.
findings.highlight: The five previously captured Color Space commands take halfword,GDI,halfword,GDI,GDI. Each command is compared against an independent ordered rectangle oracle over all129536 synthetic buffer bytes. Both positions finish with34560 changed bytes; overlap and untouched regions are included.
findings.gdi: Original GdiCreateDisplayContextEx copies the original sDcOsd8 template, and original bitmap creation/selection supplies synthetic frame geometry. Context+0x880 selects FillRect at0x80225820 via generic FillRect0x8022cf9c. Original coordinate mapping, clipping and memset run. Only allocation, GetBuffer and cache APIs are replaced.
findings.binding: Fixture seeds default context0x800eb4d8 and ID17 lookup table to the same allocated context. AppOsdSetAttributeByBufferID can replace the selected context with psDcOsd when default is null; binding is an explicit fixture condition, not evidence of actual initialization or a camera defect.
findings.bounds: Memory inspection rejects symbolic and out-of-range accesses. Original image ranges and seeded globals are readable. Native writes are confined to stack, display context, bitmap descriptor and synthetic frame. Eight-byte sentinels and full-frame equality are checked after every command. VEX write-event counts are not CPU transaction counts. Event pc is VEX scratch.ins_addr, which may attribute a delay-slot store to its branch: 0x800fb7b8/7d8/7ec correspond to MIPS stores at0x800fb7bc/7dc/7f0. The odd-x SWR case has66 VEX event bytes but64 changed bytes; full-frame equality remains the oracle.
findings.limits: No native Color Space refresh-to-raster continuous run, text glyphs, alternate nonzero style, nonidentity scaling, real display palette, scanout, DMA or LCD. Direct-store overflow is not exercised. Context construction does not establish device registration.

evidence.role: Original path branches, direct stores, GDI calls and indirect renderer

comparison.use: ARM Color Space row preparation assigns model-local text IDs 0x1f6/0x1f7 and style-dependent icons. Its list pending index and confirmation differ from Q7 immediate writes.
Separate ARM direction/focus and presentation callbacks reach their own renderer invalidation and scheduler boundaries. No numerical event, glyph or indexed-pixel compatibility is inferred.

limitations: Synthetic indexed RAM establishes palette index writes only, not actual RGB or LCD output.
The five shape tuples are forwarded as fixture inputs from the prior original refresh evidence; the full UI producer is not executed in this tool.
The original context template is hashed locally and not redistributed.
